record.title: Ganea’s conjecture for Lusternik–Schnirelmann category
record.statement:
For a finite complex $X$, is it true that
\[
\operatorname{cat}(X\times S^k)=\operatorname{cat}(X)+1
\quad\text{for all }k\ge 1?
\]

record.title: Product formula for topological complexity with a sphere
record.statement:
The analogue of Ganea’s conjecture for topological complexity asks whether, for every finite complex $X$ and every $k\ge 1$, one has
\[
\operatorname{TC}(X\times S^k)=\operatorname{TC}(X)+\operatorname{TC}(S^k)=
\begin{cases}
\operatorname{TC}(X)+1,& k\text{ odd},\\
\operatorname{TC}(X)+2,& k\text{ even}.
\end{cases}
\]
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2016/15](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/14223), page 27. Canonicalized from 2 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Attainment of topologically constrained exchange-energy minima for domain walls
record.statement:
For every $\theta\\in(0,\\pi/2]$ and $q\\in\\{-1,0,1\\}$, is

record.title: Rota’s characteristic-polynomial log-concavity conjecture
record.statement:
Let $M$ be a matroid with characteristic polynomial
$$
\chi_M(q)=\mu_0q^{r+1}-\mu_1q^r+\cdots+(-1)^{r+1}\mu_{r+1}.
$$
Then the coefficient sequence is log-concave in absolute value:
$$
\lvert\mu_{i-1}\mu_{i+1}\rvert\leq \mu_i^2
$$
for every index $1\leq i\leq r$. Equivalently, the sequence of absolute coefficient values is log-concave.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2016/19](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/14601), page 28. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Explicit lower bound for the Néron–Tate height
record.statement:

\widehat h_L(p)^{-1}\leq \max\bigl(D+g^g,\,h_F(A)\bigr)^{10^{5g}}.
\]

record.title: Erdős’s conjecture on minimizing pentagonal edges
record.statement:

$$h\left(n,\left\lfloor\frac{n^2}{4}\right\rfloor+1,C_5\right)\ge \frac{n^2}{4}-\frac{n^2}{36}+O(n).$$

\]

record.title: Quadratic Siegel’s lemma for a small isotropic vector

\[
H_E(x)\le (1+\varepsilon)\left(c_K(n)(2H(q))^{(n-d)/2}H(E)\right)^{1/d},
\]
where $d$ is the dimension of a maximal totally isotropic subspace of $(E,q)$.

record.title: Uniqueness of the 1D compressible-to-incompressible limit
record.statement:

$$\lim_{h\to0^+}\frac{d\bigl(F(h)u^*(t),u^*(t+h)\bigr)}{h}=0.$$ Consequently, $u^*$ coincides with a trajectory of the semigroup in Theorem 1.3; hence the compressible-to-incompressible limit is unique.

record.title: Schmidt’s conjecture on intersections of badly approximable sets
record.statement:
For pairs $(i_1,j_1)$ and $(i_2,j_2)$ satisfying $0<i_1,i_2,j_1,j_2<1$ and $i_1+j_1=i_2+j_2=1$, is
$$
\operatorname{Bad}(i_1,j_1)\cap\operatorname{Bad}(i_2,j_2)\neq\varnothing?
$$
Here $\operatorname{Bad}(i,j)$ is the set of $(x,y)\in\mathbb{R}^2$ for which there exists $c(x,y)>0$ such that
$$
\max\{\|qx\|^{1/i},\|qy\|^{1/j}\}>c(x,y)q^{-1}\qquad\text{for all }q\in\mathbb{N}.
$$
